Dear Hiring Manager,

This experience has strengthened my ability to understand complex engineering requirements and develop automation solutions that improve efficiency and reliability.

I am particularly interested in opportunities involving Generative AI, LLM applications, AI agents, intelligent automation, and AI-assisted software testing. I am eager to apply my combined AI and engineering experience to solve real-world challenges and contribute to innovative projects at {company}.

I am open to international relocation and remote work opportunities worldwide, and welcome consideration for positions that offer work visa sponsorship.

Please find my resume attached for your consideration. I look forward to the opportunity to discuss how my skills and experience align with your team's goals.

Yours sincerely,
Kamalesan C
AI Engineer | Generative AI | AI Agents | Python Automation
